steps.body: Zero means none. Adding zero puts nothing in, and taking zero away removes nothing.
steps.narration: Zero means none. Adding zero puts nothing in, and taking zero away removes nothing.

widget.prompt: Hop forward zero times from 6 — that is, do not move.

commonLandings.feedback: That hopped twice. Even adding one is a single step.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 6 and count on one: you land on 7.
widget.successFeedback: Adding zero would leave you on 6; one hop shows what adding ONE looks like instead.

predict.reveal: Zero means NO objects were added, so the group is untouched and the count stays 6.
